name: USTravelDocs
description: U.S. visa appointment scheduling. Check the current application's consular post and available appointment dates without booking or rescheduling.

actions.label: Sign in to USTravelDocs
actions.description: Opens USTravelDocs so the user can sign in.

actions.label: Check USTravelDocs sign-in
actions.description: Checks whether the scheduling page is signed in without making another website request.

actions.label: Check appointment availability
actions.description: Checks the current application's consular post and available appointment dates once. It does not book, reschedule, poll, or automatically retry.

applicantCount.description: Number of applicants included in the check

visaClasses.description: Visa classes for the applicants in the current application

available.description: Whether the site returned at least one appointment date

dates.description: Appointment dates exactly as returned by USTravelDocs
